prior_findings.original: Synchronous OCR/visual tools could block FastMCP request processing for long observations, including cancellation.
prior_findings.resolution: Five Mac OCR and four Mac visual public entrypoints are async. Observation workers perform read-only work. OCR and vision gates are acquired and released inside the real worker lifetime. VisualFrame.click_async only prepares/recaptures in a thread, awaits an event-loop cancellation checkpoint, then performs guarded dispatch on the event loop.

prior_findings.original: wait_for_image could exceed its requested deadline and accept a late successful observation.
prior_findings.resolution: Each _find await is wrapped in asyncio.wait_for using the remaining monotonic budget. The deadline is rechecked before accepting found and polling sleep is clamped to remaining time. Timeout/cancellation does not release the actual read-only worker gate prematurely.

source_checks: Registry replaces ocr/vision with macos_ocr/macos_vision and checks availability in the new Mac vision module. Local OCR readiness is independent of screen/input readiness. Screen OCR and template queries require capture readiness. Mutating variants still enforce target/native input requirements at invocation.
Diagnostics reports separate desktop.ocr and desktop.template_matching installed/ready/inputReady fields and checks the Mac vision module for cv2 availability.

Native OCR reads bounded regular-file bytes through one opened descriptor, checks size/mtime/ctime before and after, validates image metadata before decoding, and checks decoded dimensions. Python OCR validates response geometry and requires native dimensions to equal an actual captured frame.
Raw decoded first-frame orientation is explicit. File symlinks are intentionally followed. The implementation supplies a stable opened-file read contract and does not implement O_NOFOLLOW.

Vision OCR uses revision 3 accurate recognition, language correction off, default Simplified Chinese/English hints, and automatic detection for the default selection. No forced compute-device override remains.

Native OCR has a 60-second watchdog and Python recognition a 65-second bound. Guarded click observations retain a ten-second age bound from before capture, checked before recapture and immediately before native request. Cold recognition that exceeds ten seconds cannot produce a successful click from that observation.

Visual geometry maps both actual pixel axes into capture logical_bounds, keeps negative origins, rejects partial/outside matches and empty clipped regions, and confines matched geometry to the complete active-window target. Exact target identity, geometry and matched RGB patch are rechecked before guarded dispatch.

Template subprocess input/image sizes and raw-hit count are bounded. Matching uses a six-second internal budget and eight-second outer subprocess deadline, followed by kill/wait/pipe cleanup. A timed-out caller leaves only bounded observation work, with its gate held until cleanup.
Full OCR matching consumes the complete bounded recognized word set. The response cap is 500 words and miss/fuzzy diagnostics now consume only that capped response.
Private moved OCR helpers and Windows vision public bodies retain AST compatibility as recorded separately.
